name: Introduction and overview — Westland Lynx — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — Westland Lynx
description: Introduction and overview of the Westland Lynx: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The Westland Lynx is a twin-engine multirole helicopter built by Westland (later AgustaWestland), entering service in 1978. A specially modified Lynx set the world helicopter speed record at 249 mph in 1986 — a record that still stands. Over 450 were built in army, naval, and export versions. Baseline facts: Twin-engine multirole helicopter; service from 1978; 450+ built by Westland; speed-record holder..
